moddesc: Waits one turn in place after a while without input; the lower your stamina, the faster time moves. Inspect mode and spell aiming no longer freeze the clock but become bullet time (inspect x6, aim x3 by default; adjustable, 0 restores the pause). Draws a thin progress ring (or bar, colour follows the stamina stage) under the character by default, with an optional quiet mode that only shows up near the moment and a debug panel. Base values are in Options -> Mod Configuration.
